# ChittorTech

> ChittorTech (https://chittortech.in) is a premier IT services, software engineering, and digital solutions company based in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India. We design, build, and deploy custom web applications, mobile apps, enterprise cloud software, and AI-driven business tools for startups, mid-market businesses, and enterprises worldwide, with special focus on clients across India, the United States, the UK, and the Middle East.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: ChittorTech
- **Website**: https://chittortech.in
- **Headquarters**: Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India
- **Recognition**: Recognized by iStart Rajasthan (Department of Information Technology & Communication, Govt. of Rajasthan)
- **Primary Domain**: Information Technology Services, Custom Software Development, Web & Mobile Engineering, Cloud Solutions
- **Wikidata Entity**: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141496655

## Core Competencies & Services
- **Custom Web Development**: High-performance, SEO-optimized web applications built with Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern full-stack architectures.
- **Mobile Application Development**: Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps using Flutter and React Native.
- **Enterprise Software & ERP**: Scalable cloud ERPs, CRM platforms, accounting software, and workflow automation.
- **Specialized Industry Solutions**:
  - Cloud Property Management Systems (PMS) & Hotel Management Software
  - Temple Management Systems & Religious Trust Administrative ERPs
  - Educational Institute & School Management Portals
  - E-commerce & Multi-vendor Marketplace Platforms
- **AI & Intelligent Automation**: Enterprise AI support chatbots, conversational knowledge bases, automated customer support workflows, and predictive analytics.
- **Enterprise Cloud & Email Infrastructure**:
  - Email Deliverability Engineering & Inbox Placement (https://chittortech.in/email-deliverability-services)
  - DMARC, DKIM & SPF Compliance Setup (https://chittortech.in/dmarc-dkim-spf-setup)
  - BIMI & Verified Email Branding (https://chittortech.in/business-email-branding-bimi)
  - Enterprise DNS & Cloudflare Management (https://chittortech.in/dns-cloudflare-management)
  - Email Blacklist Removal & Reputation Recovery (https://chittortech.in/email-blacklist-removal)
  - Cloud Hosting & Production Deployment (https://chittortech.in/cloud-hosting-deployment)
- **UI/UX Engineering**: User-centric product design, design systems, modern responsive interfaces, and interactive dashboards.

## Target Audience & Geographic Reach
- **Headquarters & Local Hub**: Chittorgarh, Udaipur, Jaipur, Bhilwara, Kota, Jodhpur, and across Rajasthan, India.
- **National Delivery**: Pan-India technology partner for businesses modernizing their digital infrastructure.
- **Global / Offshore Outsourcing**: Trusted offshore engineering partner for clients in the United States (US), United Kingdom (UK), Canada, Australia, and the UAE seeking high-quality, cost-effective engineering talent.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3, GSAP.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python, Django, REST APIs, GraphQL.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase Firestore, Redis.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel, Firebase Hosting, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin).
